review_method: Actual visual inspection of full rendered page PNGs with view_image; image rendering, not text extraction or automatic bounds checks, was used to assess layout.

resolved_findings.finding: Table 6 left recall column was narrower than the right recall column and caused asymmetric interval wrapping.
resolved_findings.result: Resolved. Three numeric columns now have equal width; all point estimates and intervals fit on one line.

resolved_findings.finding: Fig 5 caption was split across pages 15 and 16.
resolved_findings.result: Resolved. The complete six-panel figure, title and full caption are on one page; axes, legends and confidence intervals remain legible.

resolved_findings.finding: Fig 6 caption opening (A) was interpreted as an ordered-list marker and caused a hanging indent.
resolved_findings.result: Resolved. Caption is a regular aligned paragraph with all panel descriptions intact.

final_visual_observations: Six figures and six tables were visually checked; no cropped axes, overlapping legends, missing table rows, clipped values or absent symbols were observed.
Inline exponents, minus signs, microvolt units and formula-related text render correctly in the main manuscript.
All 19 numbered references remain readable; journal abbreviations and the explicit arXiv preprint designation are present in the final reference section.
Long repository URLs and file paths wrap within the text area; supporting-information captions remain complete.
Pages 15 and 17 retain white space because the following figure and its complete caption are kept together. This is an accepted layout tradeoff preserving figure size and caption continuity.
